pulse.text: **Quiet 12 hours** — no new model shipped and the leaderboard is unchanged, with **Claude Opus 5 still first on the Artificial Analysis Index at 61** over Fable 5 (60) and GPT-5.6 Sol (59). The one real move is in the year-end race: **Google slipped to 10% from 12%** on Polymarket's best-model-at-end-of-2026 market while Anthropic held 68% and OpenAI held 9% across $411K traded, and Anthropic's end-of-August leg firmed to **92%** from 91%. Polymarket's "Next Claude Opus released by" market has now **resolved after Opus 5 shipped July 24**, leaving Gemini 3.5 Pro (88% by Aug 31) and the next Mythos-class model (42% by Aug 31, easing from 43%) as the nearest dated frontier releases; GPT-6 is unmoved at 65% by September and 89% by year end. In the news, **Apple passed Nvidia as the world's most valuable company** as the AI trade wobbled, with Samsung and SK Hynix falling double digits and tripping Kospi circuit breakers. Watch today's Microsoft, Meta and Amazon earnings — the first capex test after Alphabet's raised spending guide knocked its stock down.
